subject: Open Space and Resilient Park Grant Applications
overview: The council reviewed several grant-funded climate resilience initiatives, including city-wide open space planning and specific flood mitigation projects. They approved formal letters of support for grant applications related to the Open Space and Recreation Plan update and renovations at Tufts Park.

items.title: Minutes and Scheduling
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting and confirmed the next meeting for April 29.

items.title: Open Space and Recreation Plan Update
items.summary: Discussed a grant application for a comprehensive 10-year update to the city's open space plan, focusing on climate resilience, community needs, and park accessibility.

items.title: Fairfield Street Flood Mitigation and De-paving
items.summary: Reviewed a tri-city grant proposal to install permeable surfacing on Fairfield Street and support a partnership with Green and Open Somerville for residential asphalt removal.

items.title: Tufts Park Resilient Facilities Project
items.summary: Evaluated a grant application for Tufts Park featuring subsurface stormwater management chambers, heat-resilient playground materials, and a Miyawaki forest pilot.

items.title: Letters of Support
items.summary: Approved formal letters of support for the Open Space and Recreation Plan update and the Tufts Park resilient facilities grant application.

items.title: Community Events and Outreach
items.summary: Received updates on a utility bill checkup clinic and listed upcoming community events, including an invasive plants walk and an urban forest management presentation.
